This is the commit usdm-acdc-in-practice and usdm-acdc-quickstart pin. Do not edit the file:
the walkthrough exists to show what this version of the engine does. To move to a newer
commit, replace the file, update the checksums here and in `R/setup.R`, regenerate
`inputs/` with `capture/`, and expect the numbers to change.
